sections.content: Real Huda Beauty, bought through official channels, costs several times what is in that table. A genuine Huda foundation alone runs into the thousands. Nothing at Rs. 1,376 is a discounted original — it is a different product wearing a familiar name.
That is true across this market, not just here. Walk through any makeup market in Lahore or Karachi and you will find the same phenomenon on every counter.

We are not going to insult you by claiming otherwise. What we sell is affordable makeup that performs at its price, and if what you want is the real brand with its actual formula and its actual price, buy it from the official retailer. Both are reasonable decisions. Only one of them involves pretending.

sections.text: How to check any branded makeup before you pay

items: Batch code and expiry printed on the box, not stickered over
Print quality — sharp text and correct spelling. Genuine packaging is expensive to make and it shows
Smell it. Old or irritant products smell like solvent. Lipstick should smell faintly waxy, not chemical
Texture. Matte lipstick should be opaque in one swipe; if it is watery or patchy, that is what the price is telling you
Buy from a seller who takes returns, and use cash on delivery so you can open it first

sections.content: Our 7-day return and cash-on-delivery options exist for exactly this. Use them.

sections.text: Don't buy these from us if…

sections.content: You have sensitive skin, a history of reactions to cosmetics, or you're buying for someone who does. Cheap makeup is where fillers and fragrance show up first, and a rash on your lips is an expensive way to save Rs. 300.
You want the real Huda formula, the real shade range, and the real packaging. Buy the actual product. We'll never pretend this is that.

You're buying foundation without matching it first. Rs. 1,376 is a fair price for a foundation you've swatched. For one you haven't, it's a gamble — and shade names mean very little across different manufacturers.

sections.text: Where the value actually is in this list

sections.content: The five-in-one lipstick sets at Rs. 666 and Rs. 822 are the sensible entry point. Five shades to find out what suits you, for the price of one drugstore lipstick. If you're experimenting, start there.
The peel-off nail paint at Rs. 1,897 is the odd one out — twelve colours is a lot for one purchase. It makes sense for someone doing nail art regularly, and not for anyone else.
The blush at Rs. 1,116 and the foundation at Rs. 1,376 are the items I'd buy last. Base products are where quality differences matter most, and where buying cheap is least forgiving.

items.q: What is the price of Huda Beauty in Pakistan?
items.a: At BazaarNow, Huda-branded products run from Rs. 666 for a five-in-one lipstick set to Rs. 1,897 for a pack of twelve peel-off nail paints, as of November 2026.

items.q: Is this the original Huda Beauty?
items.a: No. Genuine Huda Beauty sold through official channels costs several times these prices. These are affordable products sold under a similar brand name. We would rather tell you that than let you find out.

items.q: Why is it so much cheaper than the real thing?
items.a: Because it is not the real thing. Different manufacturer, different formula, different price. If you want the actual Huda formula, buy from an official retailer.

items.q: Is cheap makeup safe to use?
items.a: Usually fine for most people, but the risk of irritation is higher than with premium products, and it is higher on lips and eyes than anywhere else. Patch test, and stop using anything that stings or smells like solvent.

items.q: Which product should I start with?
items.a: The five-in-one lipstick set at Rs. 666. Five shades, low risk, and it tells you what suits you before you spend more on base products.
